title: 同事频繁追问进度，怎样提出工作边界
topic: 同事频繁追问进度，怎样提出工作边界

source.title: Code of Conduct
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 37signals / Basecamp 公开资料。
paragraphs: We expect all active 37signals employees and contractors to:
Assume good intentions. Approach work relationships defaulting to trust and positivity.
Work “in the open” and be open to teaching and learning from others.
Be respectful and empathetic, especially when it comes to differing viewpoints and experiences.
Gracefully accept constructive criticism and direct feedback, and offer feedback in the same spirit.
We expect 37signals to be a healthy place for all staff. 37signals prohibits all forms of discrimination and harassment.

If you experience or witness something that violates our Code of Conduct, please report it to your manager or to your People Ops team via email or chat. All reports will be reviewed and investigated, and your confidentiality will be as protected as possible during the investigation.

If an employee is found to have violated our Code of Conduct, it will be permanently documented in their personnel file. Depending on the severity of the offense and the findings of the investigation, additional responses may include mandatory training, a formal reprimand, or termination. The reactive measures taken will be shared with the reporting employee when possible.
In extreme circumstances, you can report an incident anonymously. Anonymous complaints should be reserved for incidents in which you fear for your safety.
translations: 我们期望所有活跃的 37signals 员工和承包商做到：
秉持善意。以信任和积极的态度处理工作关系。
在"公开"中工作，并愿意向他人学习，也愿意教导他人。
保持尊重和同理心，尤其是在涉及不同观点和经验时。
得体地接受建设性批评和直接反馈，并以同样的精神提供反馈。
我们期望 37signals 成为对所有员工都健康的地方。37signals 禁止一切形式的歧视和骚扰。
如果您经历或目睹违反我们行为准则的事情，请通过电子邮件或聊天向您的经理或人力资源团队报告。所有报告都将被审查和调查，并且在调查期间，您的保密性将得到尽可能的保护。
如果员工被发现违反了我们的行为准则，将被永久记录在其人事档案中。根据违规的严重程度和调查结果，其他回应可能包括强制培训、正式警告或解雇。在可能的情况下，所采取的应对措施将与报告员工共享。
在极端情况下，您可以匿名报告事件。匿名投诉应保留在您担心自身安全的事件中。
fullTextParagraphs: We expect all active 37signals employees and contractors to:
Assume good intentions. Approach work relationships defaulting to trust and positivity.
Work “in the open” and be open to teaching and learning from others.
Be respectful and empathetic, especially when it comes to differing viewpoints and experiences.
Gracefully accept constructive criticism and direct feedback, and offer feedback in the same spirit.
We expect 37signals to be a healthy place for all staff. 37signals prohibits all forms of discrimination and harassment.

If you experience or witness something that violates our Code of Conduct, please report it to your manager or to your People Ops team via email or chat. All reports will be reviewed and investigated, and your confidentiality will be as protected as possible during the investigation.

If an employee is found to have violated our Code of Conduct, it will be permanently documented in their personnel file. Depending on the severity of the offense and the findings of the investigation, additional responses may include mandatory training, a formal reprimand, or termination. The reactive measures taken will be shared with the reporting employee when possible.
In extreme circumstances, you can report an incident anonymously. Anonymous complaints should be reserved for incidents in which you fear for your safety.

37signals prohibits retaliation against any 37signals employee who participates in a Code of Conduct report or investigation. If you believe you are being retaliated against, please contact the People Ops team.

An important note: Most interpersonal conflicts do not rise to the level of a Code of Conduct report. If you find a colleague rude or difficult to work with, you should address that with your manager or better yet with that colleague directly. Code of Conduct reports are reserved for serious transgressions — illegal or egregiously unethical behavior.

We respect everyone’s right to participate in political expression and activism, but we avoid having political debates on our internal communication systems. 37signals as a company also does not weigh in on politics publicly, outside of topics directly related to our business. You should be at peace with both of these stances.

The 37signals Code of Conduct is not meant to be a replacement for your EEO rights. You can pursue charges through 37signals channels and through EEOC channels simultaneously. Visit the EEOC website for more information about your employee rights.

notes.explain: 指在工作中默认同事是出于好意行事，这是一种积极的工作态度
notes.example: When a colleague misses a deadline, try to assume good intentions before jumping to conclusions.

notes.explain: 指尊重他人的观点和经历，并能够理解他人的感受
notes.example: To build a harmonious team, it's essential to be respectful and empathetic towards colleagues from different cultural backgrounds.

notes.meaning: 优雅地接受建设性批评
notes.explain: 指以开放和积极的态度接受有助于改进工作的反馈意见
notes.example: A professional employee knows how to gracefully accept constructive criticism and use it to improve their performance.

notes.explain: 指将违反行为准则的情况向上级主管汇报
notes.example: If you witness any policy violations, you should report it to your manager immediately for proper handling.

scenario.title: Agreeing on predictable progress updates
english: A teammate asks Sarah for progress several times a day while she is trying to finish a task.
Sarah wants uninterrupted focus time, and the teammate still needs a dependable way to see progress.
Sarah assumes the questions are meant to keep the work moving and proposes scheduled check-ins.
chinese: Sarah 正在集中完成任务，同事一天内多次询问进度。
Sarah 需要不被打断的专注时间，同事也需要可靠地了解进展。
Sarah 先按善意理解对方的询问，再提出固定的进度同步时间。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事一天内多次打电话追问任务进度，打断了你正在进行的数据分析。请用英文说明影响，约定固定时间发送进度，并说明遇到阻碍会提前告知；如果你正在核实问题，也给出回复时间。
firstAttempt.sample: The unscheduled calls interrupt my analysis and make it harder to focus. I’ll send a status update every Tuesday and flag any blocker sooner. I’m checking with the vendor and will come back to you by 3 p.m.
firstAttempt.rationale: 说明频繁追问的影响，提出固定更新和及时告知阻碍的做法。

words.example: I’m defaulting to trust and assuming you’re asking so you can plan your work.
words.translation: 我先按善意理解，认为你是为了安排自己的工作才询问进度。
words.note: 表示在缺乏信息的情况下选择相信他人是善意的，这是一种积极的职场态度

words.example: I’ll post a progress update in the project channel at our agreed check-in time.
words.translation: 我会在约好的同步时间把进展发到项目频道。
words.note: 指工作过程和结果对相关人员透明可见，促进信息共享和协作

words.example: We can raise concerns directly and offer constructive criticism respectfully.
words.translation: 我们可以直接提出顾虑，并尊重地给出建设性意见。
words.note: 指旨在帮助改进而非单纯指责的批评意见，是专业反馈的重要组成部分

words.example: All employees must familiarize themselves with the company's Code of Conduct to ensure compliance.
words.translation: 所有员工必须熟悉公司的行为准则以确保合规。
words.note: 组织制定的行为规范，规定了员工在工作中应遵守的标准和期望

words.example: Any disciplinary action will be documented in the employee's personnel file for future reference.
words.translation: 任何纪律处分都将记录在员工的人事档案中供将来参考。
words.note: 员工人事档案，通常包含雇佣和人事记录。

words.example: The company allows employees to file anonymous complaints when they feel uncomfortable reporting directly.
words.translation: 当员工觉得直接报告不舒服时，公司允许他们提交匿名投诉。
words.note: 匿名投诉，常见于行为准则或举报政策。

structure.original: Be respectful and empathetic, especially when it comes to differing viewpoints and experiences.
analysis: 主句是祈使句结构'Be respectful and empathetic'，其中'be'是系动词，'respectful'和'empathetic'是形容词作表语，由连词'and'连接
逗号后的'especially when it comes to differing viewpoints and experiences'是状语从句，其中'when it comes to'是固定短语，意为'当涉及...时'
'differing viewpoints and experiences'是名词短语，由连词'and'连接，其中'differing'是现在分词作定语修饰'viewpoints'
structure.transfer: Be professional and considerate, especially when dealing with diverse opinions and backgrounds.

rewrite.bad: Please stop asking me for updates. I’ll tell you when I have something.
rewrite.good: The repeated calls interrupt my analysis. Could we agree on one status update each afternoon? I’ll let you know sooner if I hit a blocker, and I’ll get back to you by 3 p.m. about the vendor question.
rewrite.translation: 反复来电打断了我的分析。我们能否约定每天下午同步一次进度？如果遇到阻碍，我会提前告诉你；关于供应商的问题，我会在下午三点前回复。
rewrite.pattern: [Interruption] affects [work]. Could we agree on [update schedule]? I’ll flag [blocker] sooner and get back to you by [time] about [open question].

cloze.prompt: I’ll send a status update every ___ and flag any blocker sooner.
cloze.why: 提出可预测的更新时间，而不是只说“别催我”。

cloze.prompt: The unscheduled calls ___ my analysis and make it harder to focus.
cloze.why: interrupt my analysis 直接说明临时来电造成的工作影响。

cloze.prompt: I’m ___ with the vendor and will come back to you by 3 p.m.
cloze.why: 给出下一次更新时间，既设边界又保持可协作。

dictation.text: During a team project, Sarah and Mike had different approaches to completing their assigned tasks, causing tension in the workflow.
Sarah preferred working independently while Mike wanted constant collaboration, creating a conflict in their work priorities and team dynamics.

translationPractice.prompt: 我每周二同步一次进度；如果遇到阻碍会提前说明。
translationPractice.answer: I’ll send a status update every Tuesday and flag any blocker sooner.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“give a status update at an agreed time”在在约定时间同步进度时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: 临时来电打断了我的分析，让我更难集中注意力。
translationPractice.answer: The unscheduled calls interrupt my analysis and make it harder to focus.
translationPractice.why: 先描述影响，再提出固定进度时间和紧急情况的沟通方式。

choice.prompt: 同事一天内多次打电话询问分析进度，影响了你的专注。请选出既说明影响、又能约定固定更新的说法。
options: Stop calling me. I do not want to explain my work.
The unscheduled calls interrupt my analysis and make it harder to focus. Could we agree on a status update every Tuesday? I’ll flag any blocker sooner.
I will answer every call, even when I have no new information.
choice.why: 说明临时来电对工作的影响，同时提供固定进度同步时间和提前告知阻碍的安排。

output.prompt: 项目搭档不断在聊天工具上追问同一项分析的进度，影响了你的专注时间。请用英文说明影响、约定固定更新频率，并说明遇到阻碍时会提前通知。
output.sample: The repeated check-ins are interrupting the analysis. I’ll post a progress update at the end of each day, and I’ll flag any blocker as soon as it comes up.
check: 是否说明频繁联系造成的具体影响？
是否提出固定的进度更新时间？
是否说明遇到阻碍或待核实事项时如何跟进？

credits.audio: 美式英语合成朗读，非公司员工原声。
